title: 2019 HMMT February Guts Problem M_{5}
statement: Let \(A=\sqrt{M_{1}}, B=\left\lceil M_{11}\right\rceil\). Given complex numbers \(x\) and \(y\) such that \(x+\frac{1}{y}=A, \frac{1}{x}+y=B\), compute the value of \(x y+\frac{1}{x y}\).

solutions.text:
12
\(A=14, B=1\). Multiplying the two given equations gives \(x y+1 /(x y)+2=14\), so the answer is \(14-2=12\).
